selection: every ID in ox/info/ids.txt; no sampling
search: all normalized occurrences against pooled database including all self hits
methods: complete monotone nonoverlapping HSP chain existence with polynomial counts
annotation_independence: structure-derived uppercase reference columns; labels withheld from BLAST and chain selection
precision_scope: residue precision restricted to uppercase eligible reference residues. Cross-family membership is unknown; no retrieval precision or orthology score.
replicate_dependence: sets may overlap and repeated sequences are retained as occurrences; unique count reported; macro family mean descriptive, no IID confidence interval
